name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 24, 2025 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

  ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
  Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
  through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
  open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

  PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
  Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
  may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
  Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
  are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
  management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
  the presiding officer.

  Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
  4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
  meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
  Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
  agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
  see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81330233596
  Webinar ID: 813 3023 3596
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,81330233596# OR 16699009128,,81330233596#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 253 205 0468
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Davis, Pearl, Halpern, Mayor Pro Tem
  McSweeney, Mayor Honig

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of September 10, 2025 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  WM PRESENTATION ON “RESIDENT CART CONTAMINATION PREVENTION
  AND PROPER WASTE SORTING” - Presented by Brian Neiens, WM Public
  Sector Manager and Stephanie Jamison, WM Recycling Education Representative

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

2939375.2
 MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

4.  Greater Conejo Valley Chamber of Commerce (Verbal Report)

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMITTEE REPORT – RESTAURANT WEEK
  – City Council to provide feedback and direction to staff on the progress and
  tentative plans for Restaurant Week.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 15-002, MODIFICATION NO. 3;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2415-25 - Adopt Resolution No. 2415-25, determining
  Modification No. 3 of Conditional Use Permit No. 15-002 is exempt from CEQA
  and authorizing the continued sale of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption
  for Q Sushi, located at 30770 Russell Ranch Road, Suite A.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2415-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING A TIME EXTENSION AND MODIFICATION OF
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 15-002, RELATIVE TO THE SALE OF ALCOHOLIC
  BEVERAGES FOR ON-SITE CONSUMPTION FOR Q-SUSHI RESTAURANT,
  LOCATED AT 30770 RUSSELL RANCH ROAD, SUITE A

2.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 20-001, MODIFICATION NO. 1;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2416-25 – Adopt Resolution No. 2416-25, determining a
  modification of Conditional Use Permit No. 20-001 is exempt from CEQA and
  authorizing the production and sale of beer for off-site consumption for Malibu
  Brewing Company, located at 31336 Via Colinas, Suite 101.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2416-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING A MODIFICATION TO CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 20-001 RELATIVE TO THE PRODUCTION AND SALE OF BEER FOR
  OFF-SITE CONSUMPTION FOR MALIBU BREWING COMPANY, LOCATED AT 31336
  VIA COLINAS, SUITE 101

3.  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 22-003, RESOLUTION NO. 2417-25 -
  Adopt Resolution No. 2417-25, determining a modification to Planned
  Development Permit No. 22-003 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing a 114
  square-foot addition to the first and second floors of an existing single-family
  residence, along with a comprehensive façade remodel including a new roof,
  windows, entryway, and exterior materials, and approximately 176 square feet of
  front and rear yard improvements at 31868 Foxfield Drive.
   OR, ALTERNATIVELY

  City Council deny a modification to Planned Development Permit No. 22-003, at
  31868 Foxfield Drive and direct staff to prepare a resolution for City Council
  adoption.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2417-25: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING A MODIFICATION TO PLANNED
  DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 22-003 AUTHORIZING A 114-SQUARE-FOOT
  ADDITION TO THE FIRST AND SECOND FLOORS OF AN EXISTING SINGLE -FAMILY
  RESIDENCE ALONG WITH A COMPREHENSIVE FAÇADE REMODEL INCLUDING A
  NEW ROOF, WINDOWS, ENTRYWAY, AND EXTERIOR MATERIALS, AND
  APPROXIMATELY 176 SQUARE FEET OF FRONT AND REAR YARD
  IMPROVEMENTS AT 31868 FOXFIELD DRIVE

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective September 15, 2025 in the
  amount of $878,196.55

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  ACCEPTANCE OF ANNUAL STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT FOR
  FISCAL YEAR 2024-25; FILE NOTICE OF COMPLETION – Accept the
  Annual Street Improvement Project for Fiscal Year 2024-25 and authorize
  the City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of Completion” for the project
  on behalf of the City.

  2.  ACCEPTANCE OF COMMUNITY PARK PARKING LOT SEAL COAT
  PROJECT; FILE NOTICE OF COMPLETION - Accept the Community Park
  Parking Lot Seal Coat Project for Fiscal Year 2025-26 and authorize the
  City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of Completion” for the project on
  behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  UPDATE ON THE 2035 STRATEGIC PLAN PROCESS - City Council to note and
  file the 2035 Strategic Plan process update report.

2939375.2
 2.  AWARD OF CONTRACT - CIVIC CENTER COURTYARD IMPROVEMENTS
  PROJECT - Approve a budget increase of $23,157.55 to the Civic Center
  Courtyard Improvements Project, award a construction contract for the project to
  JAS Landscape LLC in the amount of $313,857.55; authorize the City Manager to
  approve change orders up to the contingency amount of $45,000; and authorize
  the Mayor to execute the construction contract on behalf of the City.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE BIDS FOR THE
  ANNUAL STREET RESURFACING PROGRAM FISCAL YEAR 2025-26 - Adopt
  the plans and specifications for the Annual Street Resurfacing Program Fiscal Year
  2025-26 and authorize staff to advertise bids for the construction of the Annual
  Street Resurfacing Program Fiscal Year 2025-26.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, September 18, 2025 at 7:00 p.m. on the City’s website
and in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  September 18, 2025
